title: Sign Extension Datapath Block
statement: Create a datapath block that sign-extends a 7-bit signed input to 16 bits and then adds a constant offset of 8. The result should be a signed 16-bit value. This illustrates how sign extension is integrated into a datapath before arithmetic.
behavior: Extend a to 16 bits preserving sign from a[6].
Add a constant 8 to the extended value.
The module must be purely combinational.
Purely combinational: outputs must settle after input changes.
Do not depend on initial register values, clocks, or delays.
All outputs must be driven to known 0/1 values for every input case.
constraints: Do not use sequential storage or multiple clock domains.
hint: First extend the sign bit then perform addition.
